## Setup

```{r}
library("tidyverse")
library("here")
```

## Load data

TEMPORARY: reads the 01_load output until 02_clean is ready.

```{r}
ab_bind <- read_csv(here("data", "01_dat_load_experimental.csv"))
```

## Mutation features

Count how many mutations each variant has (number of commas + 1).

```{r}
ab_bind_aug <- ab_bind |>
  mutate(n_mutations = str_count(Mutation, pattern = ",") + 1)
```
